units.source_text: 这大夫监年约三十左右，躯干高大，肢体肥胖。

en.t: This Deputy Governor was about thirty years old, tall in the body and stout in the limbs.

units.source_text: 相貌虽不十分丑陋，然而由于印象不良，总觉面目可憎。

en.t: Though his features were not especially ugly, his unpleasant impression made his face seem hateful.

units.source_text: 他那粗鲁的举止，令人一见就觉得讨厌。

en.t: His coarse manners made people dislike him at first sight.

units.source_text: 血气旺盛，红光满面；

en.t: He was full of vigorous blood and energy, with a ruddy glow across his face;

units.source_text: 声音嘶哑，言语噜苏。

en.t: his voice was hoarse, and his speech was tiresomely wordy.

units.source_text: 大凡偷香窃玉，总是在夜间悄悄地来的，

en.t: As a rule, men who come seeking secret love do so quietly at night,

units.source_text: 所以合欢树又称为夜合花。

en.t: and so the silk tree is also called the night-closing flower.

units.source_text: 这个人却在春日傍晚前来求婚。

en.t: Yet this man came to propose marriage in the evening of a spring day.

units.source_text: 古歌云：“秋夜相思特地深。”

en.t: An old poem says, “On autumn nights, longing in love is especially deep.”

units.source_text: 现在不是秋天，

en.t: It was not autumn now,

units.source_text: 这个人却显得相思特地深的样子。

en.t: yet this man looked as though his longing in love were especially deep.

units.source_text: 这些且不谈，

en.t: Leaving such matters aside for the moment,

units.source_text: 既然来了，乳母老太太觉得不可伤情破面，便走出来接待。

en.t: since he had already come, the old nurse felt she could not offend him or shame him, and went out to receive him.

units.source_text: 大夫监开言道：“小生久仰贵府少弍大人高才大德，英名卓著，常思拜识，随侍左右。

en.t: The Deputy Governor began, “I have long admired the great talent, virtue, and renowned name of your household’s Lord Shoni, and have often wished to meet him and serve at his side.

units.source_text: 岂料小生此志未遂，而大人遽尔仙逝，令人不胜悲恸！

en.t: Who could have expected that before I fulfilled this wish, His Lordship would suddenly pass away, leaving me overcome with grief!

units.source_text: 为欲补偿此愿，拟请将府上外孙小姐交由小生保护，定当竭诚效劳。

en.t: To make up for that wish, I ask that your granddaughter, the young lady of this house, be entrusted to my protection, and I will serve her with all sincerity.

units.source_text: 为此今日不揣冒昧，斗胆前来拜访。

en.t: For this reason, I have dared to visit today, despite my presumption.

units.source_text: 贵府小姐，身份高贵，下嫁寒舍，实甚屈辱。

en.t: The young lady of your house is of noble rank, and marrying down into my humble home would truly be a humiliation for her.

units.source_text: 但小生定当奉为一家之女王，请其高居上头。

en.t: But I will certainly honor her as the queen of my household and seat her in the highest place.

units.source_text: 太君对此亲事不予快诺，想系闻知寒舍畜有微贱女子多人，因而不屑与之为伍。

en.t: If Your Ladyship has not readily agreed to this marriage, I suppose it is because you have heard that my humble house keeps many lowly women, and you disdain having her among them.

units.source_text: 但此等贱人，岂可与小姐同列？

en.t: But how could such base women ever stand in the same rank as the young lady?

units.source_text: 小生仰望小姐地位之高，不亚于皇后之位也。”

en.t: I look up to the young lady’s lofty position as one no lower than that of an empress.”

units.source_text: 他提起了精神说这番话。

en.t: He roused himself and delivered this speech with spirit.

units.source_text: 乳母老太太答道：“岂敢岂敢！

en.t: The old nurse replied, “How could I dare think such a thing!

units.source_text: 老身并无此意。

en.t: This old woman has no such intention.

units.source_text: 承蒙不弃，实甚荣幸。

en.t: It is truly an honor that you do not reject us.

units.source_text: 无奈小孙女宿命不济，身患不可见人之残疾，不能侍奉巾栉，经常私自悲叹。

en.t: Unfortunately, my granddaughter has an unlucky fate and suffers from a disability she cannot show to others; she cannot attend to a husband’s personal service and often grieves over it in private.

units.source_text: 老身勉为照料，亦不胜其痛苦也。”

en.t: I do my best to care for her, but even I can hardly bear her suffering.”

units.source_text: 大夫监又说：“此事勿劳挂虑。

en.t: The Deputy Governor said again, “Please do not trouble yourself over that matter.

units.source_text: 普天之下，即使双目失明，两足瘫痪之人，小生亦能善为治疗，使其复健。

en.t: Anywhere under heaven, even if someone is blind in both eyes and paralyzed in both legs, I can treat them skillfully and restore them to health.

units.source_text: 肥后国内所有神佛，无不听命于我也！”

en.t: All the gods and buddhas in Higo Province obey my commands!”

units.source_text: 他得意扬扬地夸口！

en.t: He boasted with triumphant self-satisfaction!

units.source_text: 接着便指定本月某日前来迎亲。

en.t: Then he named a certain day that month when he would come to fetch the bride.

units.source_text: 乳母老太太答曰：本月乃春季末月，根据乡下习俗不宜婚嫁。

en.t: The old nurse answered that this month was the last month of spring, and according to country custom it was unsuitable for marriage.

units.source_text: 暂用此言搪塞了。

en.t: For the time being, she used this excuse to put him off.

units.source_text: 大夫监起身告辞之际，忽念应该奉赠一诗，考虑了一会之后，吟道：

en.t: As the Deputy Governor rose to take his leave, he suddenly thought he ought to present a poem, and after pondering for a while, he recited:
